comment.body:
Owner authorization — nine canonical source refs and two local publication repairs

I reviewed and merged PR #70 at head
7d5ceb06f7a1814d4a95b7e4b05a2b46d8728720
(merge 0df95126d9fecd9df3cf1fd0cd88ab565a680989).

1. Nine unchanged canonical refs

I authorize creation of refs/heads/ambisgis/main at the exact proposed
commit/tree identities for the nine eligible rows in this immutable proposal:
https://github.com/aloerch/ambisgis-platform/blob/7d5ceb06f7a1814d4a95b7e4b05a2b46d8728720/plan/verification/source-ref-promotion/canonical-proposal.json

The nine repositories are ambisgis-postgresql, ambisgis-postgis,
ambisgis-jupyterhub, ambisgis-jupyterlab, ambisgis-geowebcache,
ambisgis-geoserver, ambisgis-geonode, ambisgis-mapstore and
ambisgis-mapstore-client, all under aloerch. Verify numeric repository IDs,
current review refs, publication evidence and Actions disablement first.

Create only absent refs. An already identical ref is a no-op; any other
existing ref is a collision, not permission to advance or overwrite it.
Preserve defaults, review refs, all other branches/tags and history. Keep
Actions disabled; do not enable or change unrelated automation/settings.
This does not change any repository's default branch.

2. GeoTools notice correction — local preparation, not publication

I authorize a minimal local source change adding prominent, accurate
AmbisGIS modification/date notices to:
- build/maven/xmlcodegen/pom.xml
- modules/plugin/imagemosaic/pom.xml

Preserve the original licenses and all effective POM behavior. Retain the
previous commit/history and produce a new exact commit/tree, tested patch
and publication plan for review. Do not publish the held old or changed
GeoTools refs in this run.

3. QGIS source-publication variant — local preparation, not publication

Prefer removing the exact 1,130 already package-excluded palettes from a
separately identified, publication-ready SOURCE snapshot over an open-ended
permission search. Preserve general styling functionality, the 265
ColorBrewer palettes and applicable attribution/license obligations.

I authorize preparing this snapshot in a new isolated local repository,
with no disputed ancestor content reachable from its proposed public ref.
Preserve the complete original history and notices in existing controlled
custody; record exact upstream-to-product provenance and this deliberate
public-history boundary. Do not rewrite or delete existing local/public
history, change repository visibility, or create a new public repository.

This is not a claim that existing public fork history has been purged or
that third-party rights are waived. If a specific authoritative grant
already resolves a scope, record it, but do not contact authors or adopt
new terms. Retain any additional concrete restriction as a hold.

Prepare the exact QGIS source/tree/packaging comparison and affected tests
for my review. Do not publish the held original or changed QGIS ref in
this run.

These instructions authorize the nine named canonical-ref creations and
local preparation of the two repairs. They do not authorize changed-source
publication for QGIS/GeoTools, PR merges, broad history rewrites, new
repositories, archive/binary releases, production deployment, final FND-07
acceptance or FND-08 execution. FND-02 remains accepted.
